title: 瑞银胡一帆：固定资产投资放缓是二季度经济主要拖累
speaker: You Song

segments.en: But I think the biggest doubt had probably happened in the fixed asset investments based instead of consumption.
segments.zh: 但我认为最大的问题可能出在固定资产投资，而非消费。

segments.en: So both were actually, both actually showed decent growth in one Q of the year and both likely slowed down going to the second quarter.
segments.zh: 两者在一季度都表现不错，但进入二季度都可能放缓。

segments.en: But in terms of the contribution to the slowdown, fixed asset investment growth has made a bigger contribution.
segments.zh: 但对放缓的贡献而言，固定资产投资增长贡献更大。

segments.en: And the key is the fixed asset investment growth in energy GDP accounting is not the same thing as the monthly data that we just saw.
segments.zh: 关键是，GDP核算中的固定资产投资增长与我们刚看到的月度数据不是一回事。

segments.en: We're talking about more than 40% of GDP. You saw 4% drop in fixed asset investments, right?
segments.zh: 它占GDP的40%以上。你看到固定资产投资下降了4%，对吧？

segments.en: It seems to be continuing to see downside when it comes to whether it's the property sector that's dragging these numbers.
segments.zh: 似乎持续下行，无论是房地产板块拖累这些数据。

segments.en: We had a real story earlier a few months ago about how even fiscally the government is spending less.
segments.zh: 几个月前有报道称，政府财政支出也在减少。
